walkthrough.title: Getting Started with Editor Pockets
walkthrough.description: Learn how to save, restore and organize groups of files (pockets) for the way you actually work
walkthrough.addPocket.title: Create Your First Pocket
walkthrough.addPocket.description:
Open the **Editor Pockets** view in the Explorer sidebar, then click the **+** button (or run the command below) to create an empty pocket. A pocket is a named group of files you can reopen later in one click.
[Add Pocket](command:editor-pockets.addPocket)
walkthrough.saveTabs.title: Save Your Open Tabs
walkthrough.saveTabs.description:
With several files open, click the save icon in the editor title area — or run **Save tabs to a pocket…** — to capture every open tab into a new pocket. You can also drag files from the Explorer onto a pocket to add them.
[Save Tabs](command:editor-pockets.saveTabs)
walkthrough.saveTabs.media.altText: Saving open tabs to a pocket
walkthrough.linkBranch.title: Link a Pocket to a Git Branch
walkthrough.linkBranch.description:
Right-click a pocket and choose **Related to a branch…** to bind it to a Git branch. Switching to that branch will automatically open the pocket's files — ideal for juggling features or bug fixes.
[Link Branch](command:editor-pockets.linkBranch)
walkthrough.linkBranch.media.altText: Linking a pocket to a Git branch
walkthrough.managePockets.title: Filter & Manage Pockets
walkthrough.managePockets.description:
Use the 🔍 button in the view title bar to filter pockets by name. Right-click any pocket to rename, delete, unlink its branch, or toggle **Close/Keep previous editor on switch** for that pocket individually.
[Filter Pockets](command:editor-pockets.filterPockets)
walkthrough.importExport.title: Back Up & Migrate Your Data
walkthrough.importExport.description:
From the view title **`...`** menu, run **Export Data to JSON…** to back up every pocket, or **Import Data from JSON…** to restore them on another machine.
[Export Data](command:editor-pockets.exportPockets)
